title: Organisasi #1: selaraskan revive-on-create dengan ADR-0005 — @SQLRestriction + native carcass-finder
description:
KONTEKS (modul Organisasi master, CQRS, soft-delete). RISIKO TERTINGGI. ADR-0005 mewajibkan entity master: (a) @SQLRestriction("is_deleted = FALSE") agar read JPA tidak pernah menampilkan bangkai, dan (b) pencarian bangkai untuk revive lewat NATIVE query — karena @SQLRestriction menyembunyikan bangkai dari query Hibernate biasa (termasuk Specification). Organisasi MELANGGAR keduanya.

TEMUAN TERVERIFIKASI:
- entities/master/Organisasi.java: ada @SQLDelete, TIDAK ada @SQLRestriction (grep kosong di seluruh master).
- OrganisasiCommandService.create() & update(): deteksi duplikat/bangkai pakai repository.findOne(request.getSpecification()) — Specification BIASA, bukan native.
- OrganisasiRepository.java: tidak punya native carcass-finder (bandingkan AlasanBerhentiRepository yang sudah punya — pakai sebagai pola acuan).
- AKIBAT: revive 'kebetulan jalan' justru KARENA @SQLRestriction tidak ada. Begitu seseorang menambah @SQLRestriction (agar read aman), findOne(spec) berhenti melihat bangkai → revive DIAM-DIAM RUSAK, create atas record terhapus akan melempar tabrakan unique constraint DB / membuat duplikat. Juga: update() pakai findOne(spec) tanpa filter → bisa mengembalikan bangkai → ConflictException palsu terhadap record terarsip.

TASK (junior dev / agent lokal — HATI-HATI, ubah seam):
1. WAJIB sebelum edit: gitnexus_impact({target:"Organisasi", direction:"upstream"}) DAN gitnexus_impact({target:"OrganisasiCommandService", direction:"upstream"}). Lapor blast radius; bila HIGH/CRITICAL, eskalasi ke manager (komentar issue) sebelum lanjut.
2. Tambah @SQLRestriction("is_deleted = FALSE") di Organisasi entity (impor org.hibernate.annotations.SQLRestriction).
3. Tambah native carcass-finder di OrganisasiRepository mengikuti pola AlasanBerhentiRepository — query native yang IGNORE @SQLRestriction, mencari record (termasuk is_deleted=true) berdasarkan KUNCI KEUNIKAN yang ditetapkan di Organisasi #2. Beri nama jelas, mis. findAnyByUniqueKey(...).
4. Ubah OrganisasiCommandService.create(): ganti repository.findOne(spec) → native carcass-finder. Pertahankan logika: aktif→Conflict, bangkai→revive, tidak ada→insert.
5. Ubah update(): deteksi duplikat harus hanya melihat record AKTIF (karena @SQLRestriction kini menyaring di read biasa, findOne aman untuk record aktif — verifikasi); pastikan tidak Conflict palsu terhadap bangkai.
6. Verifikasi listQuery/pageQuery JOOQ tetap benar (JOOQ filter IS_DELETED manual, tidak terpengaruh @SQLRestriction — konfirmasi).
7. ./gradlew test — SEMUA test Organisasi #4 harus tetap hijau (itu definisi 'benar'). gitnexus_detect_changes() sebelum commit.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Organisasi punya @SQLRestriction.
- Revive lewat native carcass-finder, bukan Specification.
- read JPA biasa tidak pernah menampilkan bangkai; revive tetap berfungsi (test #4 skenario c lulus).
- update tidak Conflict palsu terhadap bangkai.
- Impact analysis & detect_changes dilampirkan di komentar.

BLOCKED BY: Organisasi #2 (kunci keunikan) & Organisasi #4 (test pengaman) harus selesai dulu.
REF: ADR-0005, AlasanBerhentiRepository (pola native finder).
notes: KOREKSI TERVERIFIKASI 2026-06-18 (baca kode terkini): TEMUAN lama SALAH. Organisasi SUDAH extends MasterBaseEntity (Organisasi.java:26) dan MasterBaseEntity SUDAH punya @SQLRestriction("is_deleted = FALSE") (MasterBaseEntity.java:31). Jadi migrasi IRT untuk Organisasi SUDAH masuk. AKIBAT: ini BUKAN risiko preventif — BUG SUDAH AKTIF. create() baris 23 findOne(spec) jalan via @SQLRestriction → tak pernah lihat bangkai → cabang revive baris 25 (existing.get().getIsDeleted()) adalah DEAD CODE (mustahil true). Create atas Organisasi ter-soft-delete jatuh ke insert baris 33 → duplikat/tabrakan unique constraint. REVISI TASK: hapus langkah 2 (tambah @SQLRestriction) — SUDAH ADA via base class; tinggal langkah native carcass-finder + ganti findOne→finder di create(). Pertimbangkan naikkan ke P0 (data-integrity live).

title: Rotate leaked Appwrite API key + remove in-code default
description:
application.yml line 94 ships a real Appwrite server API key as a fallback default (${APPWRITE_API_KEY:<literal>}). The key is in git history, so deleting the literal does NOT unleak it.

ACTIONS:
1. Rotate/regenerate the Appwrite server API key in the Appwrite console (the committed key is compromised the moment it entered git; it is sent as X-Appwrite-Key on every token validation).
2. Remove the in-code default so the placeholder is ${APPWRITE_API_KEY} with NO fallback - app must fail at startup if unset (production should refuse to boot rather than run with a phantom key).
3. Store the new key only in .env / deployment secrets (already gitignored; verified .env, .env.dev, docker/development/.env are in .gitignore and not tracked).
4. OPTIONAL/heavier: history scrub (git filter-repo/BFG). Not required - rotation makes the leaked key worthless.

Context: security-module rewrite for Spring Boot 4. Dev profile never calls Appwrite, so dev does not need the key. endpoint + project_id keeping defaults is acceptable; a secret key must not.
close_reason: Code-side fix landed in commit 8a60702. application.yml + application.yml (test) now have ${APPWRITE_API_KEY} with NO fallback — app will fail at startup if the env var is unset. ./gradlew compileJava compileTestJava → BUILD SUCCESSFUL. The literal key still lives in the gitignored .env, .env.dev, .env.migrate files; user must rotate the key in the Appwrite console and update those 3 files with the new value before next deploy. History scrub explicitly noted as optional by the issue and not required once the key is rotated.

title: F3 — Pendidikan WRITE side (JPA Command) — SLICE REFERENSI
description:
SLICE REFERENSI sisi-tulis. Bergantung pada F1 (ChangedStatusResolver) dan idealnya setelah F2. 6 anak lain meniru bentuk write ini. Tiru pola gagal Master: ProfesiCommandService (services/master/profesi/) + GlobalExceptionHandler.

TUJUAN
Tulis ulang sisi-tulis Pendidikan jadi `PendidikanCommandService` ber-pola Master: TANPA try/catch swallow, lempar exception domain langsung, kembalikan entity; controller bungkus via CustomResult.save(...).

POLA GAGAL MASTER (WAJIB, ganti pola legacy SavedStatus FAILED)
- FK/entity hilang -> `.orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException(...))`.
- Duplikat aktif -> `throw new ConflictException(...)`.
- TANPA try/catch. Method create/update mengembalikan entity (parity penuh Master — keputusan grill Q15(a)).
- ConflictException(409)/NotFoundException(404) extends ApiException; GlobalExceptionHandler memetakannya ke ErrorResult. Exception tak terduga -> 500 asli (BUKAN HTTP-200 FAILED tersamar). Inilah perbaikan struktural anti-pattern legacy (try/catch -> SavedStatus.FAILED yang menelan pelanggaran constraint, akar kepegawaian-1sf).

KEPUTUSAN PROFIL YANG WAJIB DITERAPKAN
1. changedStatus DARI RESOLVER, bukan body (F1): inject `ChangedStatusResolver`; `entity.setChangedStatus(resolver.resolve())`. Body tak lagi membawa changed_status (sudah dibuang di F1).
2. ANTRI APPROVAL: bila `changedStatus == true`, panggil `profileUpdateService.create(...)` (ketergantungan satu arah profil -> updateProfile). Bila false (SDM), JANGAN antri. Apa pun rolenya, Envers tetap mencatat revisi (entity @Audited) — jangan utak-atik audit.
3. REVIVE-ON-CREATE (ADR-0019, kunci alami Pendidikan = biodata+jenjang+tahunMasuk): create dengan kombinasi yang pernah dihapus harus MENGHIDUPKAN baris lama (peek arsip via native/derived finder yang menembus @SQLRestriction), bukan baris baru. Penambahan-ulang tetap berstatus INSERT: bila pegawai menambah lalu SDM MENOLAK, baris dihapus permanen (hard-delete by id — satu-satunya pengecualian no-hard-delete, keputusan Q13) agar kunci bebas lagi. Detail mekanisme: ADR-0019 + CONTEXT.md baris 102-103.
4. SINKRONISASI isLatest -> Biodata.pendidikanTerakhir: menulis Pendidikan isLatest=true menyingkirkan isLatest dari baris lain + menyalin jenjang ke Biodata.pendidikanTerakhir, via BULK UPDATE (@Modifying @Query), BUKAN save() entity terkelola — sengaja, agar tak memunculkan revisi Envers palsu di Biodata (CONTEXT.md baris 99). Pertahankan/rapikan mekanisme ini.

LANGKAH
1. Buat `services/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanCommandService.java`: create/update/delete + addLampiran/deleteLampiran (mutasi). Hapus pola SavedStatus FAILED; pakai orElseThrow/throw.
2. Inject ChangedStatusResolver + profileUpdateService. Set changedStatus dari resolver; antri bila true.
3. Terapkan revive-on-create (peek arsip) + reject-path hard-delete by id.
4. Pertahankan sinkron isLatest via bulk update.
5. Update controller tulis: kembalikan `CustomResult.save(entity)`; @Valid + Errors tetap; mutasi @PreAuthorize sesuai konvensi.
6. Pensiunkan jalur lama PendidikanServiceImpl yang digantikan (hapus method mati yang sudah tak dipakai — JANGAN biarkan kode mati, tapi jangan pula hapus yang masih dipakai modul lain; cek pemakai dulu dengan gitnexus_impact).

ACCEPTANCE
- Tak ada try/catch swallow di PendidikanCommandService; create/update mengembalikan entity.
- changedStatus berasal dari resolver; body tak menerima changed_status.
- changedStatus=true mengantri ProfileUpdate; false tidak; keduanya tetap menghasilkan revisi Envers.
- Re-add kombinasi terhapus menghidupkan baris lama (uji); reject pegawai meng-hard-delete baris.
- isLatest sync via bulk update tetap berfungsi; tak ada revisi Envers palsu di Biodata.
- Constraint tak terduga -> 500 asli (uji lewat GlobalExceptionHandler), bukan FAILED.
- `./gradlew compileJava` + test hijau. gitnexus_impact dijalankan sebelum edit symbol; detect_changes sebelum commit.

REFERENSI BACA DULU: services/master/profesi/ProfesiCommandService.java; exceptions/{GlobalExceptionHandler,ConflictException,NotFoundException,ApiException}.java; services/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanServiceImpl.java (legacy, untuk paham saveFromBio/profileUpdateService.create di sekitar baris 152-171). ADR-0013, 0014, 0018, 0019. CONTEXT.md baris 98-106.

ATURAN: Ikuti CODING_RULES.md penuh (gitnexus_impact WAJIB sebelum edit; maks 120 baris/file). Fokus sisi-tulis Pendidikan saja. JANGAN AI SLOP — jangan ubah sisi-baca F2, jangan sentuh modul updateProfile (hanya panggil create-nya), jangan refactor di luar scope.

title: F2 — Pendidikan READ side (JOOQ) — SLICE REFERENSI
description:
SLICE REFERENSI sisi-baca. Kerjakan ini LEBIH DULU dan rapi — 6 anak lain meniru bentuk ini persis. Tiru template Master: ProfesiQueryRepository + ProfesiDetailQuery + ProfesiSelects + ProfesiRowMapper + ProfesiQueryService (semua di repositories/master/jooq/ dan services/master/profesi/).

TUJUAN
Bangun sisi-baca JOOQ untuk Pendidikan: list berpaginasi + detail satu baris, TANPA menyentuh sisi-tulis (JPA) yang lama.

BENTUK YANG DITIRU (dua-bean per anak, dari Master)
- `XxxQueryRepository`: `pageQuery(XxxIndexQuery) -> Page<XxxQuery>`. (CATATAN: untuk anak profil, JANGAN buat `listQuery()` global — lihat di bawah.)
- `XxxDetailQuery`: `getById(Long) -> Optional<XxxDetail>`, pakai JOOQ multiset untuk lampiran.
- Keduanya di-inject ke `XxxQueryService`. `getById` -> `.orElseThrow(NotFoundException)` (ADR-0014).

KEPUTUSAN PROFIL YANG WAJIB DITERAPKAN (sudah final, lihat CONTEXT.md)
1. SCOPE WAJIB per pegawai (CONTEXT.md baris ~101): `PendidikanIndexQuery` WAJIB punya `@NotBlank String biodataId` (= NIK). `baseWhere` SELALU diawali `PENDIDIKAN.BIODATA_ID.eq(biodataId).and(PENDIDIKAN.IS_DELETED.eq(false))` tanpa syarat. Kolom biodata_id menyimpan NIK string (FK referencedColumnName=nik) — tidak perlu join ke Biodata untuk scope. Controller `index` WAJIB `@Valid @ParameterObject` agar biodataId tervalidasi sebelum query jalan.
2. DROP `listQuery()`: 7 anak TIDAK punya read path global. Hanya pageQuery (yang selalu ter-scope). Ini mematikan jalur baca tak-terbatas secara konstruksi.
3. SORT WHITELIST (ADR-0017 idiom, lihat ProfesiQueryRepository.allowedSorts()): pakai `SortParam.resolve(query.getSortBy(), query.getSortDirection(), allowedSorts(), <default>)`. Untuk Pendidikan, DEFAULT SORT khusus domain = `IS_LATEST DESC, TAHUN_MASUK DESC` ('pendidikan terkini dulu'), bukan ID. allowedSorts() minimal: tahunMasuk, jenjangId (sesuaikan kolom yang masuk akal). Kolom di luar whitelist jatuh ke default — cegah SQL injection lewat sortBy.
4. PROYEKSI: `PendidikanQuery` (baris ramping untuk list) BAWA `changedStatus` (kolom biasa, bukan Envers). TANPA sub-koleksi lampiran. `PendidikanDetail` = Query + `List<LampiranRow> lampiranList` via multiset.
5. LAMPIRAN via MULTISET (context7-confirmed, ADR-style master ProfesiDetailQuery): di getById, tambah `multiset(dsl.select(...).from(LAMPIRAN_PROFIL).where(LAMPIRAN_PROFIL.REF.eq(EJenisLampiranProfil.PROFIL_PENDIDIKAN.ordinal()).and(LAMPIRAN_PROFIL.REF_ID.eq(id)).and(LAMPIRAN_PROFIL.IS_DELETED.eq(false)))).as("lampiran_list").convertFrom(r -> r.map(mapping(LampiranRow::new)))`. Predikat pakai `.ordinal()` (jujur soal kolom ORDINAL; lihat bug kepegawaian-2bz). `LampiranRow` HARUS Java `record` (bukan Lombok @Data) — Records.mapping butuh canonical ctor tunggal; @Data dengan no-arg+all-arg ctor MEMECAH mapping (lihat javadoc ApdRow/AlatKerjaRow). Taruh `record LampiranRow(...)` di `dto/profil/lampiranProfil/`, dipakai bersama semua anak. Isi binari file TIDAK di sini — tetap endpoint streaming terpisah (legacy getFileLampiranById).

LANGKAH
1. Buat `dto/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanIndexQuery.java` (extends PagedRequest, @NotBlank biodataId + filter opsional minimal).
2. Buat `dto/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanQuery.java` (baris list ramping + changedStatus) & `PendidikanDetail.java` (= Query + lampiranList).
3. Buat `dto/profil/lampiranProfil/LampiranRow.java` (record, dipakai bersama).
4. Buat `repositories/profil/jooq/PendidikanSelects.java`, `PendidikanRowMapper.java`, `PendidikanQueryRepository.java` (pageQuery saja), `PendidikanDetailQuery.java` (getById + multiset lampiran).
5. Buat `services/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanQueryService.java` (inject 2 bean; pageQuery + getById->orElseThrow).
6. Wire endpoint baca di controller (index ter-`@Valid`, getById). JANGAN ubah endpoint tulis lama di issue ini.

ACCEPTANCE
- pageQuery selalu ter-scope biodataId; tidak ada listQuery global.
- Detail memuat lampiranList via satu round-trip multiset (tanpa N+1).
- LampiranRow adalah record; kompilasi mapping sukses.
- sortBy di luar whitelist tidak mempengaruhi SQL (uji default fallback).
- Unit test: scope predicate ada; getById not-found -> NotFoundException; default sort Pendidikan = isLatest desc, tahunMasuk desc.
- `./gradlew compileJava` + test hijau. gitnexus index di-refresh bila perlu.

REFERENSI BACA DULU: src/.../repositories/master/jooq/ProfesiQueryRepository.java, ProfesiDetailQuery.java, ProfesiSelects.java, ProfesiRowMapper.java; services/master/profesi/ProfesiQueryService.java; dto/master/profesi/{ProfesiIndexQuery,ProfesiQuery,ProfesiDetail,ApdRow}.java. CONTEXT.md baris 98-106. ADR-0014, 0017.

ATURAN: Ikuti CODING_RULES.md (maks 120 baris/file — split bila lebih; gitnexus_impact sebelum edit; detect_changes sebelum commit). Fokus sisi-baca Pendidikan saja. JANGAN AI SLOP — jangan sentuh sisi-tulis, jangan kerjakan anak lain, jangan tambah filter/kolom yang tidak diperlukan.

title: F1 — ChangedStatusResolver + buang changedStatus dari request DTO
description:
FONDASI. Memblokir semua write-side slice profil. Implementasi ADR-0018 (changedStatus ditentukan server, bukan dikirim client).

TUJUAN
Buat satu komponen `@Component ChangedStatusResolver` yang menentukan nilai `changedStatus` dari ROLE principal, lalu hapus field `changed_status` dari seluruh request body profil. Ini menutup lubang bypass approval (legacy menyetel changedStatus langsung dari body).

KONTEKS PENTING (verifikasi dulu, jangan asumsi)
- `ChangedStatusResolver` BELUM ADA. grep memastikan hanya field entity/DTO `changedStatus` yang ada.
- `ROLE_SDM` sebagai Spring Security authority BELUM ADA. Saat ini 'SDM' di kode hanya jabatan pada rantai cuti, bukan role. Cek bagaimana authority principal dibaca: `config/security/JwtAuthFilter.java`, `config/security/DevAuthFilter.java`, dan entity AppwriteUser (`getAuthorities()`). Bila `ROLE_SDM` belum diemit oleh filter auth, ini bagian dari scope: pastikan authority `ROLE_SDM` bisa muncul untuk user SDM. Bila ternyata mekanisme role belum siap dan butuh keputusan produk, JANGAN tebak — buat issue baru (Scope rule CODING_RULES.md) dan tanyakan, jangan hardcode.

LANGKAH (high-level)
1. Buat `services/profil/commons/ChangedStatusResolver.java` (atau paket commons profil yang sesuai). Method tunggal, mis. `boolean resolve()`. Baca principal via `SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getAuthorities()`. Kembalikan `false` bila mengandung `ROLE_SDM` (langsung stabil, tak antri approval), `true` selainnya (menunggu approval SDM).
2. Hapus field `changed_status` dari SEMUA request DTO profil: PostRequest & PutRequest untuk pendidikan, keluarga, dan DTO profil lain yang masih membawanya (grep `changedStatus`/`changed_status` di paket dto/profil). Hapus juga baris `entity.setChangedStatus(request.getChanged_status())` di method `from(...)` DTO.
3. Resolver ini akan di-inject ke tiap XxxCommandService di issue berikutnya — JANGAN ubah service di issue ini (itu di luar scope). Cukup sediakan komponen + bersihkan DTO.

ACCEPTANCE
- `ChangedStatusResolver` ada, ter-unit-test: ROLE_SDM -> false, role lain -> true.
- Tidak ada lagi `changed_status` di request body profil mana pun (grep bersih di dto/profil PostRequest/PutRequest).
- `./gradlew compileJava` hijau.
- Bila ROLE_SDM perlu keputusan produk yang belum ada, issue baru difile dan dicatat di notes — bukan ditebak.

REFERENSI: ADR-0018 (docs/adr/0018-changedstatus-server-resolved-by-role.md).

ATURAN: Ikuti CODING_RULES.md penuh. Fokus scope ini saja. JANGAN AI SLOP — jangan sentuh CommandService/QueryService, jangan refactor di luar penghapusan field, jangan tambah abstraksi.

title: Dev profile: mutating endpoints return 403 (no static principal injected)
description: devFilterChain (@Profile("development")) uses .anyRequest().permitAll(), but @EnableMethodSecurity is active and mutating endpoints carry @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"). permitAll() only relaxes the filter chain, not method security. With no principal injected in dev, every POST/PUT/DELETE evaluates hasRole('ADMIN') against an anonymous context and returns 403 — so in development no mutating endpoint can be exercised, the opposite of the dev-bypass intent.
design: CONTEXT.md (lines 42-44,55) and ADR-0016 (locked) specify dev must inject a static principal 'DEV' with roles ADMIN+SYSTEM, overridable via DEV_ROLES (security.dev.roles: ${DEV_ROLES:ADMIN,SYSTEM}). This was the spec of CLOSED issue kepegawaian-5x7.16 / F6.S3 but shipped without the principal injection. Fix: add a dev-only filter in devFilterChain that sets a static AppwriteUser(id=DEV) authentication with roles from security.dev.roles. Verify @PreAuthorize then passes in dev. gitnexus_impact upstream on WebSecurity before editing.

title: jooqCodegen tidak menggenerate file usable: 56 compile errors (Field<Byte>.eq(boolean) + Row constructor ambiguity)
description:
## Problem

User reports: 'jooqCodeGen tidak menggenarate file ke project kepegawaian membuat aplikasi kepegawaian tidak berjalan'.

## Diagnosis (run on 2026-06-19)

`./gradlew jooqCodegen` exit 0 + BUILD SUCCESSFUL — 214 Java files generated under src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/jooq/. JOOQ generation itself works. `./gradlew compileJava` is what fails with 56 errors in repositories/master/jooq/*.java.

## Root cause (confirmed by reading generated + caller code)

1. **JOOQ generates `IS_DELETED` as `TableField<X, Byte>`** (TINYINT in DB), but call sites do `APD.IS_DELETED.eq(false)`. Java compiler cannot unbox boolean→Byte, so JOOQ's generic `Field<T>.eq(T)` fails: 'no suitable method found for eq(boolean)'. Affects all 56 errors, across all *QueryRepository.java files (AlasanBerhenti, Grade, Jabatan, Organisasi, Profesi, Level, Golongan, JenisPelatihan, Sanksi, etc).

2. **ProfesiDetailQuery.java:42,49 — constructor ambiguity**: `ApdRow` and `AlatKerjaRow` have 2 constructors (no-arg + 2-arg `Long, String`). `Records.mapping(ApdRow::new)` cannot disambiguate — error: 'invalid constructor reference; Object cannot be converted to Long'.

3. **JOOQ warnings (non-fatal, may not need fix):**
   - 'Ambiguous key name' for many-to-many FK on riwayat_sk↔pegawai (FKgkfsjfw66awvp7ve72jwuusaq, FK4aphjcvfb1eqnwb9ppx0f3h8w) — turn off implicit join paths in codegen if desired.

- Apd.java:66 → `TableField<ApdRecord, Long> ID = ... SQLDataType.BIGINT`

## Possible fixes (per JOOQ best-practice from context7)

Pick one (requires user decision before implementation):

(A) **Change call sites to `IS_DELETED.eq((byte) 0)` / `.eq((byte) 1)`** — minimal, type-correct, ~56 edits across repositories/master/jooq/*.java. Touches many files, mechanical.

(C) **Add a converter in JooqCodegenTask.kt** to coerce Byte↔Boolean at codegen time. Same blast radius as (B) but on generated code, not call sites.

(D) **Add helper DSL methods** (e.g., `IS_DELETED.eqFalse()` extension on `Field<Byte>` returning `Field<Byte>`) — Java doesn't have extension methods natively, would need a custom utility class.

**Note:** JOOQ `Field<Byte>.eq((byte) 0)` is the most surgical — Java will not autobox boolean→Byte, but explicit cast is fine. `Field<Byte>.eq(Boolean.FALSE)` does NOT compile (Boolean not assignable to Byte). So only literal `(byte) 0` / `(byte) 1` or `Byte.valueOf(0)` work.

### Researched sources

- JOOQ 3.19 manual: https://www.jooq.org/doc/3.19/manual/code-generation/codegen-advanced/codegen-config-database/codegen-database-forced-types/ + /boolean-column + /sql-execution/fetching/recordmapper
- Hibernate ORM 8.0: Basic Types / Boolean mapping (https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/main/documentation/src/main/asciidoc/userguide/chapters/domain/basic_types.adoc)
- Spring Boot 4.0-SNAPSHOT: JPA Hibernate auto-configuration (https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/4.0-SNAPSHOT/reference/data/sql.html)

### Key findings (no AI slop — sourced)

1. **MariaDB has native BOOLEAN = TINYINT(1) alias.** From Hibernate 8.0 docs: 'Boolean attributes are mapped to a database's native BOOLEAN type by default. If the underlying database lacks a dedicated boolean type, Hibernate automatically selects an appropriate alternative such as BIT, TINYINT, or SMALLINT.' MariaDB falls in 'has native' — so Hibernate picks BOOLEAN directly.

2. **JOOQ does NOT normalize like Hibernate.** It maps SQL type literally:
   - `BIT(1)` → `TableField<X, Boolean>` (true Boolean)
   - `TINYINT` → `TableField<X, Byte>` (NOT Boolean)
   - `TINYINT(1)` → `TableField<X, Boolean>` (Boolean alias)
   So JOOQ behavior matches the SQL type, not Hibernate's soft-delete convention.

3. **JOOQ 3.19 `Records.mapping(Book::new)` requires unambiguous constructor.** Doc explicitly recommends Java 16 `record` types (single canonical constructor). Lombok @Data with 2 ctors breaks it. Fix: convert DTO to `record ApdRow(Long id, String nama) {}` — removes ambiguity AND drops boilerplate.

4. **Project state confirms DDL inconsistency:**
   - `V2_0_0__create_penggajian_cuti_appwrite.sql` uses `is_deleted BIT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` (Boolean in JOOQ).
   - Master module V1 uses `TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` (Byte in JOOQ).
   - `Biodata.IS_DELETED` already maps to `Boolean` (correct).
   - This is a fresh inconsistency introduced in V1 master rewrite wave 0-5 (commit 6a8a08b). V1 wave chose `TINYINT` (probably to share migration template with Envers _AUD tables, where `BYTE` was assumed).

**Pick (E) Fix DDL V1 to use `BIT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` (matches V2 convention).** Plus (F) convert row DTOs to Java 16 records.

Reasoning:
- **(E) is the lowest-blast-radius fix.** One migration V2_1_0__alter_is_deleted_master.sql with `ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN is_deleted BIT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` per master table. 1 migration, ~30 ALTERs. Centralized in DB schema — Java call sites (`.eq(false)`) already correct. JOOQ regenerates `TableField<X, Boolean>` automatically.
- (A) `IS_DELETED.eq((byte) 0)` = ~56 mechanical edits across many files = high churn, easy to miss one.
- (B) `withForcedTypes` in JooqCodegenTask.kt = hides type mismatch from JOOQ. AI-slop risk: future readers wonder why `IS_DELETED` shows Boolean in JOOQ but TINYINT in DB. Source-of-truth split.
- (C) Custom converter = same as (B) but worse — adds runtime converter overhead.
- (D) Helper class = verbose; doesn't fix root cause.
- **(F) Java 16 records** is a no-brainer for DTOs that JOOQ consumes. Removes `Records.mapping` ambiguity, drops Lombok noise, aligns with JOOQ 3.19 recommended pattern from docs.

### AI-slop guards (per refactor-workflow-defaults.md)

- DO NOT write a custom converter when JOOQ already has `withForcedTypes` — pick the official primitive, don't invent.
- DO NOT default to `TINYINT` because 'Envers uses byte'. That conflates 2 unrelated concerns (audit storage vs soft-delete semantics). `BIT(1)` is the project-wide convention already established in V2 — follow the existing pattern.

2. Convert `dto/master/profesi/ApdRow.java` + `AlatKerjaRow.java` to Java 16 records.
3. Re-run `jooqCodegen` → confirm `IS_DELETED` is now `TableField<X, Boolean>` for master tables.
4. `compileJava` should pass.
5. Run `gradlew test` (existing test suite covers the pageQuery + getById flow per `kepegawaian-organisasi-getbyid-bug-2026-06-18`).

## Root cause (final, after DB verification)

MariaDB `kepegawaian_dev_new.<table>.is_deleted` is `bit(1)` (verified via mariadb client 2026-06-19). V1_0_0__create_master.sql DDL also BIT(1). JOOQ 3.19 MariaDB dialect maps BIT(1) → SQLDataType.TINYINT (Byte) by default — known behavior. JOOQ does NOT normalize like Hibernate does.

Generated code: `TableField<ApdRecord, Byte> IS_DELETED = createField(DSL.name("is_deleted"), SQLDataType.TINYINT...)`.

Call sites: `IS_DELETED.eq(false)` — Java cannot unbox boolean→Byte. Result: 56 errors in compileJava across `repositories/master/jooq/*.java`.

Secondary: `ApdRow`/`AlatKerjaRow` were Lombok @Data classes with both no-arg and 2-arg ctor. `Records.mapping(ApdRow::new)` cannot disambiguate.

1. `buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/JooqCodegenTask.kt` — added:

   ```
     .withName("BOOLEAN")
     .withIncludeExpression("\\bis_deleted\\b")
   ```
   on `Database.withForcedTypes(...)`. No type filter (MariaDB alias BIT→TINYINT in JDBC info, so withIncludeTypes("BIT") doesn't match). Expression-only matches column name in any table.

2. `dto/master/profesi/ApdRow.java` + `AlatKerjaRow.java` — converted to Java 16 `record`. Unambiguous canonical constructor. No Lombok @Data needed.

# Plan — Author Missing Non-Master Flyway Migrations (CQRS rewrite)

Branch: `rewrite/master-cqrs`. You are writing the migrations that another agent (this grill) deliberately did NOT write. Goal: make the app BOOT though the rewrite is incomplete. The app currently cannot start: `ddl-auto: none`, so Hibernate validates the live entity model against the Flyway schema and FAILS — only `master` + 16 reference tables exist, every other module's table is missing.

## Acceptance oracle (the ONLY definition of done)

Hibernate schema `validate` under **MariaDBDialect** passes on a DB built purely by Flyway. There is no other oracle. Do not eyeball; let Hibernate validate.

1. **FIRST checkpoint, before writing any SQL:** in `src/main/resources/application.yml:34` change `dialect: org.hibernate.dialect.MySQLDialect` → `org.hibernate.dialect.MariaDBDialect`. All column types below are chosen to satisfy MariaDBDialect's `validate`.
2. Build the schema from scratch with Flyway, set `ddl-auto: validate` temporarily (or run the app), confirm zero validation errors. Revert `ddl-auto` to `none` when green.

## Scope — 62 new objects (NOT 32)

`validate` also validates Envers `_AUD` tables and `REVINFO`. Current migrations (V1–V4) create **zero** `_AUD` and **no REVINFO**, yet V2 already created 8 `@Audited` reference tables. So the missing set is larger than the 32 entity tables:

| Bucket | Count | What |
|---|---|---|
| REVINFO | 1 | Envers revision table (built-in defaults) |
| `_AUD` backfill for V2's already-existing audited refs | 8 | tables exist, `_AUD` siblings missing |
| New entity tables | 32 | the missing non-master tables |
| New `_AUD` for the 32 | 21 | 20 class-level + 1 partial (gaji_batch_root) |
| **Total** | **62** | |

V1 master entities are NOT audited — no `_AUD` backfill for master.

## File layout — per-module, FK order (REVINFO first)

Create under `src/main/resources/db/migration/`. Within each file: any `_AUD` table goes AFTER its base table; REVINFO is global and comes first overall.

- `V5_0_0__create_revinfo.sql` — REVINFO only.
- `V5_0_1__create_profil.sql` — biodata, kartu_identitas, keahlian, lampiran_profil, pelatihan, pendidikan, pengalaman_kerja, ProfilKeluarga, ProfilUpdate (+ their `_AUD`).
- `V5_0_2__create_pegawai.sql` — pegawai (+ pegawai_AUD).
- `V5_0_3__create_kepegawaian.sql` — lampiran_sk, riwayat_cuti, riwayat_keluar, riwayat_kontrak, riwayat_mutasi, riwayat_sk, riwayat_sp, riwayat_terminasi, statistik_pegawai (+ `_AUD` for audited ones).
- `V5_0_4__create_cuti.sql` — cuti_approval, cuti_approval_chain, cuti_klaim_detail, cuti_kuota, cuti_pegawai (+ `_AUD` for audited ones).
- `V5_0_5__create_penggajian.sql` — gaji_batch_master, gaji_batch_master_proses, gaji_batch_potongan_tkk, gaji_batch_root, gaji_batch_root_error_logs, gaji_batch_root_lampiran, gaji_phdp (+ gaji_batch_root_AUD partial). **ALSO put the 8 V2-ref `_AUD` backfill here** (dasar_gaji_AUD, detail_dasar_gaji_AUD, gaji_komponen_AUD, gaji_parameter_setting_AUD, gaji_pendapatan_non_pajak_AUD, gaji_potongan_tkk_AUD, gaji_profil_AUD, gaji_tunjangan_AUD) — base tables already exist from V2.
- `V5_0_6__create_master_hari_libur.sql` — hari_libur (not audited).

FK order rationale (verified against `@ManyToOne/@OneToOne`): profil tables depend only on V2 refs (JenjangPendidikan, JenisKitas, JenisKeahlian, JenisPelatihan) + Biodata; pegawai depends on Biodata + V1/V2 master refs (Golongan, Grade, Jabatan, Organisasi, Profesi, GajiProfil, GajiPendapatanNonPajak, RumahDinas); kepegawaian + cuti depend on Pegawai (+ RiwayatSk self-order within kepegawaian: riwayat_sk before riwayat_mutasi/riwayat_terminasi); penggajian tables have no cross-module FK; hari_libur standalone.

## Delete V4, fold into CREATE

Delete `V4__gaji_status_to_varchar.sql` — it ALTERs `gaji_batch_root` which no migration creates, so on a fresh Flyway DB it fails. Instead, in `gaji_batch_root` CREATE define `status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL` directly (entity: `@Enumerated(STRING) @Column(nullable=false,length=32)`).

## House style (copy V1_0_0__create_master.sql exactly)

For entities extending `MasterBaseEntity` (audit columns inherited):
```
id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
... business columns ...,
is_deleted BIT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
created_by VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) DEFAULT NULL ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
INDEX idx_<table>_is_deleted (is_deleted)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```
FK columns nullable, `FOREIGN KEY (...) REFERENCES ... ON DELETE SET NULL`. Add the entity's own `@Index`/`@Table(indexes=...)` declarations as INDEX clauses (e.g. gaji_batch_root has 7).

NOTE: not every entity extends MasterBaseEntity — READ each entity file. Some (e.g. GajiBatchRoot, Biodata) declare their own audit fields / `@Id` / `columnDefinition` directly. `columnDefinition` is verbatim-authoritative; honor it over the crib (e.g. GajiBatchRoot.notes → `TEXT`; GajiBatchRoot.isDeleted has `columnDefinition="boolean default false"` → MariaDB renders BIT(1)/tinyint — let validate confirm).

## Type crib (MariaDBDialect)

Long→BIGINT · Integer→INT · Boolean→BIT(1) · String→VARCHAR(255) or @Column(length) · @Lob/large text→LONGTEXT, columnDefinition TEXT→TEXT · LocalDateTime→DATETIME(6) · LocalDate→DATE · BigDecimal→DECIMAL(p,s) per @Column(precision,scale) · @Enumerated(STRING)→VARCHAR(len) else INT (ordinal). Derive every non-inherited column by reading the entity field + its annotations. Do NOT guess column lists — read the .java.

## Envers `_AUD` / REVINFO rules (built-in defaults — config is COMMENTED in application.yml:36-42)

- Suffix `_AUD`, revision col `REV`, type col `REVTYPE`. AuditRevisionListener commented → REVINFO has ONLY the two default columns.
- **REVINFO**: `REV INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, REVTSTMP BIGINT`. (No username/action columns.)
- **Class-level `@Audited` table** `X_AUD`: all of X's persistent columns, PLUS `REV INTEGER NOT NULL`, `REVTYPE TINYINT`. Composite PK `(REV, <X's pk>)`. FK `REV → REVINFO(REV)`. `_AUD` tables carry NO `is_deleted`/audit-FK constraints to other `_AUD`; they mirror columns but relax FKs (Envers does not FK business columns). Keep `_AUD` columns nullable except the PK pair. Let `validate` dictate exact nullability — it checks column presence/type, build minimal and iterate.
- **Field-level `@Audited`** (gaji_batch_root ONLY): `gaji_batch_root_AUD` = `id` (PK part) + `updated_by` + `is_deleted` + `REV` + `REVTYPE`. PK `(REV, id)`. NOTHING else.
- `@Audited(targetAuditMode=NOT_AUDITED)` (Biodata, and the V2 refs detail_dasar_gaji/gaji_komponen/gaji_potongan_tkk/gaji_profil/gaji_tunjangan): entity IS audited (gets `_AUD`); only its relations are not. Treat as normal class-level `_AUD`.

### `_AUD` inventory (authoritative — from source scan)

CLASS-LEVEL @Audited among the 32 (→ full `_AUD`, 20): cuti_approval, cuti_kuota, cuti_pegawai, lampiran_sk, riwayat_cuti, riwayat_kontrak, riwayat_mutasi, riwayat_sk, riwayat_sp, riwayat_terminasi, pegawai, gaji_phdp, biodata, kartu_identitas, keahlian, lampiran_profil, pelatihan, pendidikan, pengalaman_kerja, ProfilKeluarga.

FIELD-LEVEL @Audited (→ partial `_AUD`, 1): gaji_batch_root.

NOT audited among the 32 (→ NO `_AUD`, 11): cuti_approval_chain, cuti_klaim_detail, riwayat_keluar, statistik_pegawai, hari_libur, gaji_batch_master, gaji_batch_master_proses, gaji_batch_potongan_tkk, gaji_batch_root_error_logs, gaji_batch_root_lampiran, ProfilUpdate.

V2-ref `_AUD` BACKFILL (base table exists, add `_AUD`, 8): dasar_gaji, detail_dasar_gaji, gaji_komponen, gaji_parameter_setting, gaji_pendapatan_non_pajak, gaji_potongan_tkk, gaji_profil, gaji_tunjangan. (Read each entity for column list; their base tables are in V2.)

## Table-name overrides (verbatim — affects table AND `_AUD` name)

- `ProfilKeluarga` entity → table `ProfilKeluarga` (mixed-case) → `_AUD` = `ProfilKeluarga_AUD`.
- `ProfileUpdate` entity → table `ProfilUpdate` (mixed-case, NOT audited → no `_AUD`).
- `pegawai`, `gaji_batch_root_lampiran` → explicit but equal to default snake_case.
- All others: Hibernate default snake_case of class name.

## Special cases

- **Biodata**: `@Id private String nik` (assigned String PK, NOT Long IDENTITY — no AUTO_INCREMENT); `@Version private Long version = 1L` → `version BIGINT`. Class-level `@Audited(targetAuditMode=NOT_AUDITED)`. `biodata` PK = `nik VARCHAR(...)` (read @Column for length, default 255/16 — verify). `biodata_AUD` PK = `(REV, nik)`. FK targets: JenjangPendidikan (V2).
- **GajiBatchRoot**: `@Id private String id` (assigned String, no @GeneratedValue → no AUTO_INCREMENT); declares its OWN audit fields (createdBy/createdAt/updatedBy/updatedAt/isDeleted) NOT via MasterBaseEntity; `status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL`; `notes TEXT`; 7 indexes. Two `@OneToMany(mappedBy=...)` → NO FK column on this table (FK lives on child gaji_batch_root_lampiran / gaji_batch_root_error_logs). `gaji_batch_root_AUD` partial as above.
- Entities with assigned (non-generated) String PKs get NO AUTO_INCREMENT. Most others extend MasterBaseEntity → `id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT`.

## Out of scope

- `pref_role` (V2, seed-only, no entity) — already exists, leave alone.
- V3 seed files, V1, V2 — do not touch (except: delete V4).
- Do NOT change entity Java. Schema must mirror entities AS-IS.
- Do NOT enable the commented Envers/schema-gen blocks in application.yml.

- [ ] V5_0_0..V5_0_6 created; 62 objects total (1 REVINFO + 32 tables + 29 `_AUD`).
- [ ] Fresh Flyway build + Hibernate `validate` under MariaDBDialect → 0 errors.
- [ ] `ddl-auto` reverted to `none`.

title: GajiBatchRoot: status pakai enum.ordinal() — rapuh terhadap reorder enum
description:
P1: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:178-180 menyimpan entity.setStatus(EProsesGaji.WAIT_VERIFICATION_PHASE_2.ordinal()) — yaitu INT ordinal enum — ke kolom status (kemungkinan kolom TINYINT/INT).

Bug latent:
- Reorder enum EProsesGaji (mis. tambah nilai baru di tengah) → ordinal bergeser → data existing di-DB jadi mismatch dengan kode baru. Mis. WAIT_VERIFICATION_PHASE_2 tadinya ordinal=3, setelah tambah satu enum di atasnya jadi ordinal=4 — semua row lama di-reload akan salah di-interpret.
- Inkonsistensi type: line 168-169 baca byId.get().getStatus().equals(EProsesGaji.PROSES.value()) — bandingkan int dengan String, kemungkinan return false terus (type mismatch). Ini mungkin sebab utama status check tidak jalan.

Dampak: data corruption, status transisi tidak bergerak benar, bug process gaji macet di fase salah.

Detail implementasi perbaikan:
- Opsi A (least change): simpan .name() (String) di entity & DB. Migrate kolom status ke VARCHAR(32). Update line 178-180, 168-169, semua query.
- Opsi B (type-safe): buat custom converter AttributeConverter<EProsesGaji, String> (JPA) — Spring auto-handle saat save/load. Tidak perlu migrasi kolom kalau DB-nya VARCHAR, hanya fix sisi Java.
- Opsi C (least invasive): pakai @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) di entity field, Hibernate handle konversi. Kalau kolom DB INT, perlu migration.
- Rekomendasi: Opsi B (converter) — paling clean, type-safe, tidak ubah schema kalau DB sudah VARCHAR. Audit DB schema dulu.

Acceptance:
- Simpan & load satu entity bolak-balik, nilai enum konsisten
- Reorder enum test: tambah dummy enum di tengah, verifikasi data lama masih valid
- Hapus inkonsistensi .value() vs .ordinal() di semua call-site (line 168-169 minimal)

title: GajiBatchRoot.save(): hasil kafkaTemplate.send() diabaikan — kegagalan kirim senyap
description:
GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.save() baris 81 memanggil kafkaTemplate.send(PENGGAJIAN_TOPIC, save.getId()) tanpa menangani CompletableFuture yang dikembalikan. send() bersifat async/non-blocking: jika broker down, metadata timeout, atau serialisasi gagal, error muncul di future dan TIDAK terlihat. Method tetap return ESaveStatus.SUCCESS padahal pesan trigger penggajian tidak pernah terkirim — batch tersimpan di DB tapi proses hilir tidak pernah jalan (silent data loss).

Dampak: batch gaji 'sukses' tapi tidak diproses; sulit dideteksi karena tidak ada log error.

Konteks (Spring Kafka docs via context7): send() mengembalikan CompletableFuture<SendResult>. Pola yang benar:
  kafkaTemplate.send(topic, id).whenComplete((result, ex) -> { if (ex != null) { /* log + tandai batch FAILED / simpan ke GajiBatchRootErrorLogs */ } });

Rekomendasi implementasi:
1. Tangkap future dari send(), daftarkan whenComplete callback.
2. Pada ex != null: log error, dan persist kegagalan (entity GajiBatchRootErrorLogs sudah ada) atau set status batch ke FAILED agar bisa di-reprocess.
3. Pertimbangkan pola transactional outbox jika konsistensi DB+Kafka kritikal (lihat issue terkait dual-write).

Lokasi: src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/services/penggajian/gajiBatchRoot/GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:81 dan reprocessHandler() baris 166. Tidak perlu rewrite sekarang — issue ini untuk agent implementor.

title: F6.S2: Migrasi klien Appwrite WebClient -> RestClient (drop webflux)
design:
Patuhi WORKING AGREEMENT epic 5x7 (gitnexus dulu, context7 dulu, DRY/KISS, SCOPE KETAT).

TUJUAN: Hilangkan WebFlux. Ganti WebClient (reactive) dengan Spring RestClient (sinkron) untuk panggilan Appwrite. Sekaligus perbaiki semantik error yang sekarang ditelan jadi null.

context7 WAJIB: Spring Framework 7 `RestClient` — builder/baseUrl, `.get().uri(...).header(...).retrieve().body(Class)`, dan penanganan status `.onStatus(HttpStatusCode::is4xxClientError, ...)` / 5xx. Pastikan paket & API.

gitnexus WAJIB: gitnexus_context untuk JwtTokenService + WebClientConfig + AuthController; gitnexus_impact({direction:"upstream"}) pada JwtTokenService SEBELUM edit — WARN bila HIGH/CRITICAL (filter auth bergantung padanya).

FILE (SCOPE KETAT):
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/WebClientConfig.java -> jadikan RestClientConfig: bean RestClient (RestClient.builder().baseUrl(${appwrite.endpoint}).build()). Rename file/kelas via gitnexus_rename, BUKAN find-replace.
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/security/JwtTokenService.java -> pakai RestClient. getUserFromToken(): GET {endpoint}/account/jwt + header X-Appwrite-Project / X-Appwrite-Key / X-Appwrite-JWT, body -> AppwriteUser.
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/controllers/auth/AuthController.java -> /auth/session pakai RestClient (bukan WebClient). HAPUS endpoint /auth/csrf-token (CSRF dibuang di rewrite security; RedisHelper.generateToken tak dipakai lagi di sini).

SEMANTIK ERROR (perbaikan inti, jangan dilewat):
- Lama: try/catch menelan SEMUA error jadi null -> semua tampak 401. SALAH.
- Baru: pakai .onStatus. Token ditolak Appwrite (401/403) -> lempar yang dipetakan ke 401 Unauthorized. Appwrite tak terjangkau / 5xx / timeout -> petakan ke 503 Service Unavailable. Jangan kembalikan null buta.

DRY/KISS: satu bean RestClient dipakai bersama. Jangan bikin wrapper/abstraksi tambahan. Jangan retry/circuit-breaker (di luar scope — buat issue baru bila perlu).

ANTI-SLOP: jangan menambah DTO baru selain yang sudah ada (AppwriteUser/Prefs). Jangan ubah signature publik JwtTokenService kecuali perlu untuk membedakan 401 vs 503.

Alur tutup: gitnexus_detect_changes() -> hanya 3 file di atas + rename -> ./gradlew compileJava -> bd close.
acceptance_criteria: Tidak ada lagi import org.springframework.web.reactive.* di kode app; JWT valid -> AppwriteUser ter-resolve; token salah -> 401; Appwrite mati -> 503 (bukan 401); kompilasi hijau tanpa webflux.

title: E0 (EXEMPLAR): Golongan — pola kanonik CQRS satu entity master flat
design:
Implementasi Golongan END-TO-END sebagai POLA RUJUKAN. Semua entity master lain meniru struktur ini — buat sebersih mungkin. Golongan = entity flat paling sederhana (tanpa relasi).

WAJIB gitnexus dulu: gitnexus_context({name:"GolonganServiceImpl"}) & gitnexus_query untuk paham perilaku CRUD lama yang ditiru. WAJIB context7 untuk JOOQ DSL (selectFrom, pagination, sort), Spring Data JPA save, jakarta validation.

=== STRUKTUR FILE (layer-first, ADR-0006) — SCOPE KETAT, hanya file Golongan ===
ENTITY (write):
- entities/master/Golongan.java — extends MasterBaseEntity (F5); field domain: kode, nama. @SQLDelete/@SQLRestriction.

DTO:
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganRequest.java — write DTO (POST/PUT body), @Valid. Field: kode, nama.
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganQuery.java — read row DTO (index/list/{id} projection). HANYA field yang dipakai klien (jangan over-fetch).
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganIndexQuery.java — filter index (free-text → ilike; FK/enum/int → equal). Extends/compose PageQuery (F4).

COMMAND (write side):
- services/master/golongan/GolonganCommandService.java — @Service concrete (ADR-0007, no interface). create→insert (201 {id}); update→load-or-404 (ADR-0014) lalu apply; delete→soft-delete-or-404. Revive-on-create bila unik bentrok row soft-deleted (ADR-0005). FK (jika ada) via getReferenceById→EntityNotFoundException→409 (ADR-0008). Tidak ada di Golongan, tapi catat polanya.
- services/master/golongan/GolonganMapper.java — PURE function: Request→Entity & sebaliknya untuk write. Tanpa side-effect, tanpa akses repo.

QUERY (read side, JOOQ):
- services/master/golongan/GolonganQueryService.java — @Service concrete; orchestrate, panggil GolonganQueries.
- services/master/golongan/GolonganQueries.java — DSL JOOQ: page query (offset/limit), sort whitelist (cegah SQL injection lewat nama kolom), proyeksi ke GolonganQuery. GET/{id} hilang → throw NotFoundException→404 (ADR-0014).

REPO:
- repositories/master/GolonganRepository.java — Spring Data JPA (write side saja).

CONTROLLER:
- controllers/master/GolonganController.java — @RequestMapping("/master/golongan"). 
  GET index (paged via @ParameterObject GolonganIndexQuery), GET list, GET /{id}, POST, PUT /{id}, DELETE /{id}.
  Mutasi (POST/PUT/DELETE) WAJIB @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"). Bungkus respons via helper F4 (ApiResponse). Controller TIPIS — delegasi ke service, tanpa logika.

=== ATURAN ===
- DRY/KISS: command pakai JPA, query pakai JOOQ. TANPA bus, TANPA interface+Impl. Mapper pure.
- DROP: batch endpoint, @Version, Envers.
- SCOPE KETAT: hanya file Golongan + daftar di atas. Jangan sentuh entity lain.
- gitnexus_detect_changes() sebelum commit — pastikan hanya symbol Golongan berubah.

Rujukan ADR: 0005, 0006, 0007, 0008, 0010, 0013, 0014. Memory: rewrite-package-layout, rewrite-master-base-class, rewrite-fk-getreference, rewrite-revive-on-create-unique-softdelete, rewrite-jooq-page-query, rewrite-write-success-codes, rewrite-index-filter-contract.
Selesai: 6 endpoint Golongan jalan end-to-end; `./gradlew test` hijau; ini jadi rujukan semua E* berikut.

title: F5: Base class master (@MappedSuperclass) + JPA auditing
design:
Buat base entity master & infrastruktur JPA auditing. (Konfigurasi security DIPISAH ke issue S1–S3; F5 fokus persistence saja.)

WAJIB context7 dulu: Spring Data JPA @MappedSuperclass + AuditingEntityListener, @EnableJpaAuditing, AuditorAware, Hibernate @SQLDelete/@SQLRestriction (Boot 4 / Hibernate 7). Versi internalmu mungkin basi.

WAJIB gitnexus dulu: pahami base entity & pola soft-delete lama via gitnexus_context (mis. AbstractEntity / kolom audit lama).

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT):
- MasterBaseEntity (@MappedSuperclass): id (IDENTITY Long), created_by/at + updated_by/at (JPA auditing), is_deleted. DROP @Version, @Audited/Envers, changed_status (ADR-0003, 0010). Field audit TIDAK masuk DTO response apa pun.
- @SQLDelete + @SQLRestriction("is_deleted = FALSE") pola soft-delete (diwarisi entity master).
- AuditorAware bean untuk created_by/updated_by. @EnableJpaAuditing aktif.

DRY/KISS: satu base class diwarisi semua entity master. Jangan duplikasi kolom audit per-entity.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0003, 0010; memory rewrite-master-base-class. Selesai: kompilasi; @EnableJpaAuditing aktif; soft-delete bekerja.

title: F4: Foundation slice — ApiResponse, PageResult, RestControllerAdvice, typed exceptions
design:
Buat artefak kontrak bersama yang dipakai SEMUA endpoint master. Dibangun sebelum endpoint apa pun.

WAJIB context7 dulu: Spring Framework 7 @RestControllerAdvice, MethodArgumentNotValidException, Jackson 3 serialisasi Instant ISO-8601 default, ResponseEntity di Spring 7. Cek apakah ProblemDetail auto-aktif (kita TOLAK ProblemDetail, ADR-0013).

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT — buat baru di package commons/dto + exception):
- ApiResponse<T>(int status, String statusText, T data, Instant timestamp) — record, envelope sukses & error (ADR-0013).
- PageResult<T> + PageQuery records (paging response & request) — bentuk dari memory rewrite-jooq-page-query.
- Helper builder respons sukses: POST→201 {id}, PUT→200 {id}, DELETE→200 null, GET-by-id→200 data.
- GlobalExceptionAdvice (@RestControllerAdvice, SATU-satunya): 
  * MethodArgumentNotValidException → 400, data = list "field : message" (paritas ErrorResult lama).
  * EntityNotFoundException (dari getReferenceById, ADR-0008) → 409.
  * NotFoundException typed (baru) → 404 (ADR-0014, untuk GET/{id}/update/delete row hilang).
  Semua dirender sebagai ApiResponse<Object>, BUKAN ProblemDetail (ADR-0013).
- NotFoundException (typed) untuk 404.

DRY/KISS: satu advice, satu envelope sukses+error. Jangan bikin per-controller error handling.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0008, 0013, 0014; memory rewrite-error-envelope-symmetric-apiresponse, rewrite-get-by-id-missing-404, rewrite-jooq-page-query.
Selesai: kelas-kelas kompilasi; unit test kecil advice memetakan 3 exception → status benar.

title: F3: Task Gradle codegen JOOQ via GenerationTool (manual, sumber di-commit)
design:
Buat satu custom Gradle task imperatif yang menjalankan codegen JOOQ via org.jooq.codegen.GenerationTool.generate(config) — BUKAN plugin (ADR-0012).

WAJIB context7 dulu: API GenerationTool & org.jooq.meta.jaxb.* (Configuration, Jdbc, Generator, Database, Target), Testcontainers MariaDBContainer, Flyway programmatic migrate. Versi internalmu mungkin basi.

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT):
- build.gradle.kts (tambah task `jooqCodegen` saja; jangan ubah dep app yang sudah di F1)
- buildSrc/ ATAU blok task inline — pilih yang paling KISS.

Rantai task (ADR-0012, di SATU task):
1. start Testcontainers MariaDB
2. Flyway migrate ke kontainer itu
3. ambil JDBC URL live kontainer sebagai variabel LOKAL → serahkan ke org.jooq.meta.jaxb.Jdbc
4. GenerationTool.generate(config) → output ke src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/jooq/
5. stop kontainer

KRITIS (ADR-0015):
- Task ini TIDAK disambungkan ke compileJava. Dijalankan MANUAL (`./gradlew jooqCodegen`) hanya saat skema berubah.
- Output sumber JOOQ DI-COMMIT ke git (src/main/java/.../jooq/). compileJava & CI TIDAK PERNAH start kontainer.
- Target package generated: id.perumdamts.kepegawaian.jooq.

DRY/KISS: nol bridging URL — URL hanya variabel lokal. Satu titik kendali up→migrate→generate→down.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0012, 0015. Selesai: `./gradlew jooqCodegen` menghasilkan sumber JOOQ ter-commit untuk tabel master dari F2.

title: F2: Flyway V1 master migration + seed (schema source of truth)

Tulis migration Flyway V1 untuk seluruh tabel master + seed dev. Flyway = sumber kebenaran skema; Hibernate ddl-auto=validate (ADR-0002).

WAJIB gitnexus dulu: pahami skema lama dari entity di src/.../entities/master/ (17 entity). WAJIB context7 untuk sintaks Flyway (penamaan versi, flyway-mysql untuk MariaDB).

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT):

- src/main/resources/db/migration/V1_0_1__seed_master.sql (seed dev, gantikan SetupMaster yang dibuang)

Tabel: golongan, level, jenjang_pendidikan, jenis_keahlian, jenis_pelatihan, jenis_kitas, alasan_berhenti, rumah_dinas, hari_libur, organisasi(self-ref parent_id), jabatan(self-ref + level_id + golongan_idx), grade(self-ref + level_id), profesi(+ level_id denorm dari jabatan per ADR-0009), apd(profesi_id FK), alat_kerja(profesi_id FK), jenis_sp, sanksi(jenis_sp_id FK).

Seed (V1_0_1): isi data referensi yang dulu di-hardcode SetupMaster (mis. Golongan 18 baris). Ini menggantikan GET /setup-master yang dibuang.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0002, 0009, 0010, 0011. Selesai: `./gradlew flywayMigrate` (atau bootRun dev) sukses migrate ke MariaDB lokal.

title: F1: build.gradle.kts — Gradle Kotlin DSL untuk Spring Boot 4.0.3 + JOOQ
design:
Buat/migrasi build script ke Gradle Kotlin DSL (build.gradle.kts) untuk Spring Boot 4.0.3 (Spring Framework 7, Spring Security 7), Java 21.

WAJIB context7 dulu: cek koordinat & API Spring Boot 4.0.3 BOM, Spring Dependency Management, plugin Gradle Kotlin DSL, JOOQ 3.19+, Flyway, Testcontainers MariaDB, springdoc-openapi 3.0.x. Versi internalmu mungkin basi.

title: Rewrite modul MASTER ke Spring Boot 4 + CQRS (JPA write / JOOQ read)
design:
Rewrite modul `master` dari nol ke arsitektur baru. Bahasa TETAP Java; hanya build script jadi build.gradle.kts. Lightweight CQRS: JPA sisi tulis, JOOQ sisi baca, satu MariaDB. Tujuan inti: DTO response spesifik per-endpoint (hanya muat relasi yang dipakai endpoint itu) — bukan satu DTO gemuk over-fetch seperti kode lama.

Cakupan entity master (17 entity + 5 enum read-only):
- Flat: Golongan, Level, JenjangPendidikan, JenisKeahlian, JenisPelatihan, JenisKitas, AlasanBerhenti, RumahDinas, HariLibur
- Tree self-ref: Organisasi, Jabatan, Grade
- Aggregate: Profesi (APD & AlatKerja dilipat ke dalamnya)
- Standalone: JenisSp + Sanksi (TIDAK dilipat)
- Enum read-only: StatusKerja, StatusPegawai, JenisKontrak, JenisMutasi, JenisSk
- DIBUANG: SetupMaster (diganti Flyway seed), semua batch endpoint.

=== WORKING AGREEMENT (BERLAKU UNTUK SEMUA CHILD ISSUE) ===
1. PAHAMI DULU lewat gitnexus sebelum ngoding: `gitnexus_query`/`gitnexus_context` untuk mengerti perilaku kode lama yang ditiru. Jalankan `gitnexus_impact({direction:"upstream"})` SEBELUM mengedit symbol apa pun; WARN bila risiko HIGH/CRITICAL.
2. CEK context7 untuk API library SEBELUM menulis (Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7, Spring Security 7, JOOQ, Flyway, Hibernate). Pengetahuan internal bisa basi. [SKIP context7 untuk: refactor murni, biz-logic, code review.]
3. DRY + KISS. Jangan over-engineer, jangan bikin abstraksi yang tak diminta, jangan command/query bus (ADR-0001), jangan interface+Impl — pakai concrete @Service (ADR-0007). 3 baris mirip lebih baik daripada abstraksi prematur.
4. SCOPE KETAT — kurangi AI Slop: HANYA sentuh file yang disebut di issue. JANGAN mengubah/merapikan file lain. Bila butuh perubahan di luar scope, BUAT ISSUE BARU (`bd create --deps discovered-from:<id>`), jangan lakukan diam-diam.
5. Soft-delete only (is_deleted), jangan hard-delete. Endpoint mutasi WAJIB @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')").
6. Patuhi ADR yang dirujuk tiap issue (docs/adr/). Jangan langgar keputusan terkunci.
7. Alur: `bd update <id> --claim` sebelum mulai → ngoding → `gitnexus_detect_changes()` sebelum commit (pastikan hanya symbol yang diharapkan berubah) → `./gradlew test` → `bd close <id>`.
8. JANGAN jalankan codegen JOOQ di CI/compileJava (ADR-0012/0015). Generate manual lokal, commit hasilnya.

Kerjakan child issue SESUAI URUTAN dependency (bd ready menampilkan yang sudah unblocked). Foundation dulu, lalu exemplar Golongan, lalu sisanya meniru pola exemplar.

title: F9 — Biodata READ+WRITE (akar agregat + cascade seed Q19)
description:
Bergantung F1, F2, F3, F4. Biodata adalah AKAR AGREGAT, bukan baris anak — ia ADALAH pegawai (kunci NIK), tak punya induk untuk diacu. Berbeda dari 7 anak.

TUJUAN: sisi-baca + sisi-tulis Biodata, dengan dua kekhususan: (1) READ global ala master, (2) WRITE create men-seed dua anak (Q19).

READ — PENGECUALIAN GLOBAL (CONTEXT.md 101): Biodata BOLEH punya read global ala master (filter opsional nik/nama/jenisKelamin/alamat/isPegawai TANPA scope wajib) — ini 'pencarian direktori' sah bagi SDM, bukan kebocoran. Jadi Biodata BOLEH punya listQuery/pageQuery global (beda dari 7 anak yang wajib biodataId). Tiru bentuk master ProfesiQueryRepository (boleh ada listQuery global di sini). SortParam whitelist default ID. BiodataQuery (ramping) & BiodataDetail.

WRITE — CASCADE SEED (Q19, keputusan grill, CONTEXT.md baris baru ~101): `BiodataCommandService.create` = Biodata + seed 2 anak, dalam SATU @Transactional (gagal salah satu -> batal semua):
  - seed KartuIdentitas kosong: panggil `KartuIdentitasCommandService.seedFromBiodata(biodata)` (method baru yang HARUS disediakan F4 — bila belum ada, koordinasikan; JANGAN reach ke repo anak langsung).
  - seed Pendidikan awal isLatest=true (jenjang dari pendidikanTerakhir input): panggil `PendidikanCommandService.seedFromBiodata(biodata, jenjang)` (method baru dari F3).
  SEMANTIK SEED: aktor = SISTEM, bukan pegawai. Maka changedStatus=FALSE DITETAPKAN EKSPLISIT (BUKAN lewat ChangedStatusResolver — sistem bukan role) dan TIDAK memanggil profileUpdateService.create (tak ada yang menyetujui data buatan sistem). Seed TETAP menghasilkan revisi Envers (entity @Audited) -> persist via save() biasa. (Ini formalisasi 'bare repository.save' legacy jadi method bernama eksplisit.)
  Pola gagal Master untuk create Biodata sendiri (orElseThrow/throw, kembalikan entity, tanpa swallow). update/patch juga dipindah dari pola SavedStatus FAILED ke pola Master.

CATATAN PENTING: method `seedFromBiodata` ada di CommandService anak (F3/F4), DIPANGGIL oleh BiodataCommandService — arah dependensi Biodata -> child command service (arah yang sudah ada di legacy saveFromBio/execSave). JANGAN duplikasi logika isLatest/pendidikanTerakhir di Biodata; itu invariant milik Pendidikan.

ACCEPTANCE: create Biodata menyemai 1 KartuIdentitas + 1 Pendidikan isLatest=true dalam satu transaksi; seed changedStatus=false eksplisit; seed TIDAK mengantri ProfileUpdate; seed TETAP memunculkan revisi Envers; read global direktori berfungsi (filter opsional); compile+test hijau; gitnexus_impact sebelum edit (cascade menyentuh banyak symbol — laporkan blast radius), detect_changes sebelum commit.

CHECKLIST:
- [x] BiodataQuery — JOOQ result DTO
- [x] BiodataIndexQuery — extends PagedRequest, filter global (nik/nama/jenisKelamin/alamat/isPegawai)
- [x] BiodataDetail — full detail dengan JOOQ multiset pendidikan + kartuIdentitas
- [x] BiodataSelects + BiodataRowMapper — column projections + RowMapper
- [x] BiodataQueryRepository — pageQuery + listQuery global
- [x] BiodataDetailQuery — getById dengan multiset
- [x] BiodataQueryService — pageQuery + getById + findAll
- [x] BiodataCommandService — CRUD + saveFromPegawai
- [x] BiodataController — rewrite endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE + foto-profil)
- [x] PendidikanCommandService.seedFromBiodata() — method baru
- [x] KartuIdentitasCommandService.seedFromBiodata() — method baru
- [x] Delete legacy BiodataService + BiodataServiceImpl
- [x] compileJava + compileTestJava hijau
- [x] gitnexus_impact + detect_changes

REFERENSI: services/profil/biodata/BiodataServiceImpl.java (legacy save baris 69-86, saveFromPegawai 89-97); services/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanServiceImpl.java saveFromBio (152-158); hasil F3/F4; CONTEXT.md baris seed Biodata + 101; ADR-0018.
ATURAN: CODING_RULES.md penuh (gitnexus_impact WAJIB — ini symbol berisiko tinggi). Fokus Biodata + pemanggilan seed. JANGAN AI SLOP — jangan reimplement logika anak, jangan sentuh modul updateProfile selain memanggilnya.

title: F8 — ProfilKeluarga READ+WRITE (arsip & aktif boleh berdampingan)
description:
Bergantung F1, F2, F3. ProfilKeluarga VARIAN KHUSUS: baris aktif dan baris arsip BOLEH BERDAMPINGAN; menambah ulang setelah hapus = baris BARU (BUKAN revive). Hanya duplikat AKTIF persis yang ditolak (CONTEXT.md 104). Beda dari Pendidikan/KartuIdentitas (yang revive) dan beda halus dari append-only trio (di sini ada cek duplikat aktif).

TUJUAN: sisi-baca + sisi-tulis ProfilKeluarga meniru F2/F3, dengan aturan duplikat 'tolak hanya jika aktif persis sama'.

READ (tiru F2): ProfilKeluargaIndexQuery @NotBlank biodataId; baseWhere BIODATA_ID.eq + IS_DELETED.eq(false); TANPA listQuery global; SortParam whitelist default ID; ProfilKeluargaQuery (+changedStatus) & ProfilKeluargaDetail (+lampiranList multiset, REF=PROFIL_KELUARGA.ordinal()).

Envers mencatat.

ACCEPTANCE: arsip+aktif berdampingan teruji; re-add setelah hapus = baris baru (bukan revive); duplikat aktif persis ditolak; scope wajib; multiset PROFIL_KELUARGA; compile+test hijau; gitnexus gates.

REFERENSI: F2/F3; entities/profil/ProfilKeluarga.java; services/profil/keluarga/ProfilKeluargaServiceImpl.java (legacy); CONTEXT.md 104.

ATURAN: CODING_RULES.md. Fokus ProfilKeluarga saja. JANGAN AI SLOP.

title: Re-add of soft-deleted Pendidikan/KartuIdentitas fails with raw ConstraintViolationException
description: Legacy defect (kepegawaian-legacy). Pendidikan has unique key {biodata_id, jenjang_id, tahun_masuk} and KartuIdentitas {nik, jenis_kitas_id}, both with is_deleted OUTSIDE the constraint plus @SQLDelete + @SQLRestriction. Soft-deleting a row leaves it physically occupying the unique key. The duplicate-check reads THROUGH @SQLRestriction so it only sees LIVE rows: Pendidikan PendidikanServiceImpl:65 (repository.exists(spec)) and KartuIdentitas KartuIdentitasServiceImpl:64 (findOne(Example.of(...))). On re-add of a previously-deleted key the check sees nothing -> save() -> DB unique-key violation -> raw ConstraintViolationException. Pendidikan swallows it into a generic FAILED via its try/catch; KartuIdentitas is unguarded. Net effect: a user can never re-add an education entry / identity card they previously deleted. Fix lands in the profil CQRS rewrite via master-style revive-on-create (look up the archived row by natural key and reactivate it, like ProfesiCommandService). See CONTEXT.md revive-on-create three-way split and bd memory profil-rewrite-q12-revive-on-create-resolved-three.

title: OrganisasiCommandService.update() does not guard archived (soft-deleted) duplicates
description: update() checks only repository.findOne(request.uniquenessSpecification()), which respects @SQLRestriction and sees live rows only. Editing an Organisasi so its nama+parent matches a soft-deleted (archived) Organisasi is silently allowed, creating a hidden duplicate that will collide on revive. CONTEXT.md line 63 says this edit must be rejected.
design: Mirror ProfesiCommandService.update() (lines 72-78): after the live-dup check, also peek archived rows via a native/IsDeletedTrue finder on the unique key (nama+parentId) and throw ConflictException if a different id matches. Revive stays create-only. Reference: OrganisasiCommandService.create() already uses findAnyByUniqueKey (native, bypasses @SQLRestriction) — reuse that for the archived check. gitnexus_impact upstream on OrganisasiCommandService.update before editing.

title: fix(profesi-getbyid): JOOQ multiset() emits multi-statement set @@group_concat_max_len; MariaDB Connector/J rejects (bad SQL grammar 500)
description:
Root cause: ProfesiDetailQuery.getById() uses jOOQ 3.19 multiset() to nest apd_list / alat_kerja_list subqueries. JOOQ wraps the SELECT with 'SET @t=@@group_concat_max_len; SET @@group_concat_max_len=4294967295; <select>; SET @@group_concat_max_len=@t' to give group_concat() a 4GB headroom. MariaDB Connector/J rejects multi-statement by default (no allowMultiQueries=true in jdbc:mariadb://... in application.yml:20) → SQLSyntaxErrorException: bad SQL grammar → 500.

Fix options:
(A) JooqConfig with Settings.withRenderGroupConcatMaxLenSessionVariable(false) — RECOMMENDED. group_concat() defaults to @@group_concat_max_len (1MB on MariaDB) which is ample for APD/alat-kerja per profesi.
(B) allowMultiQueries=true on JDBC URL — NOT recommended (multi-statement SQLi risk).
(C) Rewrite as JOIN + JSON_ARRAYAGG — bigger change, eliminates dependency.

Verify ApdDetailQuery & AlatKerjaDetailQuery have same problem when their getById is called.

Repro:
GET /master/profesi/{id}
→ 500 with body.data=null, errors=['Internal server error: jOOQ; bad SQL grammar [set @t = @@group_concat_max_len; ...]']

Context7: jOOQ 3.19 settings-group-concat — 'This is useful when statement batches are not possible in a single JDBC statement.'

title: fix: Flyway V4__gaji_status_to_varchar.sql fails on missing gaji_batch_root table in kepegawaian_dev_new

title: GajiBatchRoot: KafkaTemplate<String,Object> tapi value-serializer StringSerializer — payload non-String akan gagal serialisasi
description:
application.yml mengkonfigurasi spring.kafka.producer.value-serializer = StringSerializer, tapi bean disuntik sebagai KafkaTemplate<String, Object> (GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:37). Saat ini yang dikirim adalah save.getId() yang bertipe String (GajiBatchRoot.id adalah @Id String) sehingga KEBETULAN aman. Namun tipe generic Object menyembunyikan kontrak: jika ada yang mengirim objek non-String (mis. DTO/Long), StringSerializer akan melempar SerializationException saat runtime, bukan compile-time.

Masalah tambahan: KafkaConfig.java tidak mendefinisikan ProducerFactory/KafkaTemplate bean kustom — hanya NewTopic. Listener consumer di KafkaConfig dikomentari (baris 26-29) dan blok consumer di application.yml juga dikomentari. Artinya: tidak ada konsumen di aplikasi ini → perlu dikonfirmasi apakah konsumen ada di service eksternal (penggajian) atau memang fitur belum jalan (dead pipeline).

Rekomendasi:
1. Persempit tipe ke KafkaTemplate<String, String> agar sesuai StringSerializer dan kontrak eksplisit di compile-time; ATAU
2. Jika memang butuh kirim objek, ganti value-serializer ke JsonSerializer dan definisikan ProducerFactory yang tepat di KafkaConfig.
3. Dokumentasikan/konfirmasi keberadaan consumer (service penggajian eksternal?) — kalau tidak ada, seluruh pipeline kafka ini no-op.

Lokasi: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:37, config/KafkaConfig.java, application.yml:54-57. Rekomendasi saja.

title: GajiBatchRoot.save(): dual-write DB + Kafka tanpa batas transaksi — risiko pesan terkirim padahal DB rollback
description:
GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.save() TIDAK beranotasi @Transactional (bandingkan findAll() yang malah @Transactional padahal read-only). Di dalam save() ada beberapa write berurutan: repository.save(entity) (81), gajiBatchRootLampiranRepository.save() (78), processPotonganTkk.process() yang melakukan saveAll() (47), lalu kafkaTemplate.send() (81).

Masalah:
1. Tanpa @Transactional, tiap save() commit terpisah (auto-commit). Jika processPotonganTkk.process() melempar exception (RuntimeException 'Failed to process the spreadsheet file'), root + lampiran sudah ter-commit tapi proses potongan gagal → state setengah jadi.
2. kafkaTemplate.send() dipanggil setelah semua write. Bila method dibungkus @Transactional, send() async tetap bisa terbang sebelum/independen dari commit DB → pesan terkirim walau DB rollback (dual-write problem klasik).

Konteks (Spring Kafka docs via context7): untuk konsistensi DB+Kafka gunakan transactional outbox, atau ChainedKafkaTransactionManager/executeInTransaction. Minimal: bungkus seluruh save() dengan @Transactional sehingga write DB atomik, dan pindahkan/kondisikan kafka send agar hanya jalan setelah commit sukses (mis. TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization afterCommit, atau pola outbox).

Rekomendasi:
1. Tambahkan @Transactional (org.springframework) pada save() agar 3 write DB atomik.
2. Kirim Kafka di afterCommit hook ATAU implementasikan outbox table untuk reliability penuh.
3. Hapus @Transactional yang salah tempat di findAll() (read-only, lihat issue terkait).

Lokasi: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:52-86. Hanya rekomendasi — untuk agent implementor.

title: LampiranProfil.ref uses @Enumerated(ORDINAL) — latent corruption risk
description: LampiranProfil.ref is mapped @Enumerated(EnumType.ORDINAL), so the persisted column stores the enum's positional index. Reordering or inserting a constant in EJenisLampiranProfil (PROFIL_KELUARGA, PROFIL_PENDIDIKAN, PROFIL_PELATIHAN, PROFIL_KEAHLIAN, FOTO_PROFIL, KARTU_IDENTITAS, PROFIL_PENGALAMAN_KERJA) silently remaps every existing row to the wrong jenis. The profil JOOQ read side (XxxDetail lampiran multiset) works around this by deriving the predicate from EJenisLampiranProfil.X.ordinal() rather than a hardcoded int, so read code tracks the enum against the current schema — but the underlying ORDINAL storage remains fragile. Proper fix: migrate ref column to @Enumerated(STRING) with a data backfill. Deferred out of the profil read-side rewrite because it touches existing persisted data (migration + backfill). Surfaced during grill-with-docs Q17.
