title: GajiBatchRoot: catch (Exception) menelan stack trace + @Transactional salah tempat di findAll() read-only
description:
Dua code-smell di GajiBatchRootServiceImpl yang menurunkan kualitas & observability:

1. Catch-all yang menelan exception (save, reprocess, verify1, verify2, accept — semua sama):
   catch (Exception e) { return SavedStatus.build(ESaveStatus.FAILED, e.getMessage()); }
   - Stack trace hilang (tidak ada log.error). Bug Kafka/DB jadi sulit didiagnosis — hanya pesan singkat ke client.
   - e.getMessage() bisa null (mis. NullPointerException) → client dapat pesan FAILED kosong.
   - Menangkap Exception termasuk RuntimeException tak terduga yang seharusnya bubble up.
   Rekomendasi: tambahkan logging (Slf4j log.error('...', e)) sebelum return; pertimbangkan exception handler terpusat (@RestControllerAdvice) daripada try/catch berulang di tiap method.

2. @Transactional di findAll() (baris 40) padahal method read-only — seharusnya @Transactional(readOnly = true) atau dilepas. Sebaliknya save() yang melakukan multi-write JUSTRU tidak @Transactional (lihat issue terkait dual-write). Anotasi transaksi terbalik penempatannya.

3. Catatan minor: jakarta.transaction.Transactional dipakai (import baris 18) — di Spring lebih disarankan org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional agar dukung readOnly & propagation penuh.

Lokasi: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:18,40,83-85,96-98,110-112,124-126,138-140. Rekomendasi untuk agent implementor.

value: Rewrite Profesi.level_id: keep denormalized (ADR-0009, Q34=B). level_id is a real FK column but NEVER from a request field — it's a denormalized copy of jabatan.level (old code: entity.setLevel(jabatan.getLevel()) in ProfesiPutRequest.toEntity). Command side LOADS full Jabatan via jabatanRepository.findById(jabatanId).orElseThrow(ResourceNotFoundException) [real SELECT, documented exception to ADR-0008 for THIS FK only — because reading jabatan.getLevel() forces SELECT, Jabatan can't stay a getReferenceById proxy], then p.setLevel(jab.getLevel()), stores level_id. Organisasi+Grade stay proxies per ADR-0008. levelId filter stays on stored profesi.level_id column (no join on read). Trade-offs accepted: drift risk if jabatan re-leveled (no reconciliation, YAGNI) + 1 extra SELECT per create/update vs preserved old behavior+schema. Bad jabatanId -> 404 naming Jabatan (more precise than generic 409). Context7 deliberately SKIPPED (domain/data-modeling decision).

Rewrite soft-delete: master entities sudah punya @SQLDelete+@SQLRestriction, tapi service lama deleteById pakai manual setIsDeleted(true)+save() — itu sebabnya @SQLDelete 'tidak jalan' (hanya menyala saat repository.delete()/EntityManager.remove(), bukan save). Rewrite: service Command panggil repository.delete() saja, buang set manual. Sisi baca JOOQ memintas Hibernate jadi @SQLRestriction TIDAK berlaku di JOOQ — wajib helper terpusat (Conditions.active(table)) untuk filter is_deleted=false di setiap query baca.

MASTER revive bug: @SQLRestriction('is_deleted=FALSE') on MasterBaseEntity:31 applies to JpaSpecificationExecutor.findOne(spec) too (Hibernate filters Criteria/Spec queries), so the findOne-based revive branch in 15/16 master CommandServices is DEAD CODE — it can never see a soft-deleted carcass. Only OrganisasiCommandService is correct (native findAnyByUniqueKey, ADR-0005). To read tombstones you MUST use nativeQuery. Symptom is governed by FLYWAY DDL not entity @Index (ddl-auto=none → @Index(unique=true) is inert); only real DB unique = idx_jenis_sp_kode, so JenisSp re-create of archived kode 500s while the other 14 silently insert duplicate active rows. Fix tracked in epic kepegawaian-toe (Tasks o51/n99/6ek/6p7).

Rewrite master entities DROP @Version/version column entirely (ADR-0010). @Version is Hibernate optimistic locking, NOT audit — verified via context7 hibernate-orm: Envers (@Audited) is independent, audits via separate *_AUD tables (REV/REVTYPE), never reads version. Deductive from: (1) Envers doesn't need @Version, (2) ADR-0003 master is NOT audited, (3) Q36=A master write contract doesn't expose concurrency (last-write-wins parity). So version column would be written by Hibernate but never read/audited/checked → KISS removes it. Master Flyway migration must NOT create a version column. SCOPE GUARD: rewrite master only; old IdsAbstract untouched; penggajian/kepegawaian are audited + may have contention so @Version is a fresh decision there, NOT a blanket project-wide removal.

HariLibur adalah SATU-SATUNYA index master yang menyimpang dari locked index-filter contract (free-text->ilike, FK/enum/int->equal). Filter index-nya CALENDAR-SHAPED, faithful port dari kode lama (HariLiburRequest): tahun (default LocalDate.now().getYear()) + bulan (Integer, opsional) + jenisLibur (EJenisLibur, equal). Di JOOQ read query: year(HARI_LIBUR.TANGGAL).eq(tahun) dan month(HARI_LIBUR.TANGGAL).eq(bulan), bukan equal pada raw date. Alasan: kalender hari libur secara domain di-browse per tahun/bulan, bukan per tanggal persis; raw-date equal salah bentuk. Ini per-entity EXCEPTION terhadap kontrak filter index, didokumentasikan sebagai memory BUKAN ADR (faithful port perilaku yang sudah ada, trivially reversible, tidak mengejutkan untuk kalender). Deductive (no fork, silent): (1) revive-on-create ADR-0005 berlaku apa adanya, hanya native tombstone lookup-nya findAnyByTanggal(LocalDate) bukan tuple nama -> UNIQUE(tanggal); (2) jenisLibur enum->equal sudah tercakup kontrak. HariLibur tetap CRUD standar /master/hari-libur (first-class lookup, bukan dilipat). Entitas: tanggal LocalDate (UNIQUE) / jenisLibur EJenisLibur / notes String.

Rewrite master base class (MappedSuperclass) final shape, distinct from old IdsAbstract. KEEP: id (IDENTITY Long); Spring Data JPA auditing created_by/created_at + updated_by/updated_at via @CreatedDate/@CreatedBy/@LastModifiedDate/@LastModifiedBy + @EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener.class) — Q37 keep-all-four: cheap operational forensics, parity, standard practice, independent of Envers/@Version, NOT exposed in any master response DTO; is_deleted (soft delete, CLAUDE.md mandate). DROP: @Version/version column (ADR-0010); @Audited Envers (ADR-0003, master not audited); changed_status (deductive — grep proves it's used ONLY in profil module ProfilKeluarga/Pendidikan approval workflow, never master; it leaked into shared old base). Note: Spring Data JPA auditing (created/updated inline columns) is a THIRD independent mechanism — separate from Envers (@Audited *_AUD tables) AND from @Version (optimistic lock). Q37 keeps it; ADR-0003 drops Envers; ADR-0010 drops @Version — all three orthogonal. Also: timestamps serialize via Jackson3 ISO-8601 default, NOT old @JsonFormat yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

Master read DTOs: the self-referential parent reference (Organisasi.parent, Jabatan.parent) gets its OWN mini record preserving {id, kode, nama, shortName} — NOT collapsed to the uniform RefItem(id,nama). Reason: old API already returns parent.kode + parent.shortName; collapsing would silently drop two response fields (breaking change). Cheap via JOOQ self-join. RefItem(id,nama) stays only for true id+nama-only refs (Profesi APD/alat-kerja children). Decided in grilling Q35=A.

Profil rewrite Q12 (revive-on-create) RESOLVED — three-way split per entity, decided by whether a natural unique key exists and whether is_deleted is inside it: (1) Pendidikan {biodata_id,jenjang_id,tahun_masuk} + KartuIdentitas {nik,jenis_kitas_id} — is_deleted NOT in constraint, both @SQLDelete/@SQLRestriction → soft-deleted row occupies key → CommandService MUST do revive-on-create + collision-check like master ProfesiCommandService. This also FIXES a latent legacy re-add bug: legacy dup-checks read through @SQLRestriction (Pendidikan repository.exists(spec); KartuIdentitas findOne(Example.of)) so they only see live rows → re-adding a soft-deleted entry hits raw ConstraintViolationException (swallowed as generic FAILED in Pendidikan). (2) ProfilKeluarga {biodata_id,version,nama,tanggal_lahir,is_deleted} — is_deleted IN constraint → live+archived coexist → NO revive, only live-exact-dup check. (3) keahlian/pelatihan/pengalamanKerja/lampiranProfil — no unique constraint, append-only → NO revive, NO collision. Documented in CONTEXT.md Relationships.

Rewrite read semantics (ADR-0014): GET /master/x/{id} on an absent row (never existed OR soft-deleted, hidden by @SQLRestriction is_deleted=FALSE) THROWS a typed not-found -> ADR-0013 advice renders ApiResponse status 404, data=null. NOT 200-with-data:null. Old code returned null from findById -> wrapped as 200 data:null (ProfesiServiceImpl.java:44-45); update missing -> SavedStatus.FAILED 'Unknown Profesi' (not 404); delete missing -> false. ADR-0013 already made mutating update/delete-on-missing = 404 (they go through advice); GET was the open fork because a normal null return isn't an exception. Chosen A=uniform 404 (GET/update/delete all agree 'missing'=404, REST-correct, client uses status not body null-check) over B=keep 200-null parity (rejected: read/write disagree on missing, 200 hides absence). Same typed exception as ADR-0013 -> no new advice branch. Soft-deleted reads identical to never-existing (read API hides tombstones). Applies to single-resource GET /{id} only; index/collection empty = 200 empty list. Deliberate break from old 200-null read parity.

Rewrite Organisasi: GET /master/organisasi/{id}/parent is KEPT by name (client compat) but re-implemented. OLD impl was a copy-paste bug: findByParentId() ignored the parent and returned the node itself via findById(id), identical to findById endpoint (OrganisasiServiceImpl.java:46-50) — never actually served a tree. NEW contract: return the node's DIRECT CHILDREN as a plain UNPAGED list (List<OrganisasiListItem>-style), i.e. children whose parent_id = {id}. Rationale: index already supports ?parentId=X (paged) for children; /{id}/parent is the convenience unpaged variant. Note the name is misleading (says 'parent', returns children) but kept to avoid breaking existing frontend callers. JOOQ read side: SELECT ... WHERE parent_id = {id} AND is_deleted=false. Master trees (Organisasi, Jabatan) are otherwise FLAT in responses: embed parent as a mini record (Q35), never nest a children[] array. Jabatan has NO /{id}/parent endpoint (its /organisasi/{id} is a legit working filter), so this quirk is Organisasi-only. Not an ADR (reversible endpoint contract, low surprise once documented).

Rewrite master: ONE request record per entity (e.g. ProfesiRequest), used by BOTH save (POST /master/x) and update (PUT /master/x/{id}). id always from path variable, never in body. Rationale: in old code every master XPutRequest is an EMPTY subclass of XPostRequest (zero added fields, identical validation); Golongan/Grade/Level already share a single PostRequest. Records cannot extend, so keeping Post/Put split would mean copy-pasting all fields+annotations into a second record for no behavioral difference. DRY+KISS -> collapse to one. NOT an ADR (splitting later is a trivial forward change). Validation annotations live on the single record's components. Create-vs-update divergence handled in the Service layer (revive-on-create ADR-0005 affects only Profesi command path, not DTO shape), not via separate DTOs.

Rewrite master write-success response body = MINIMAL ACK, never a Detail DTO. POST /master/x -> 201 with ApiResponse.data = { id } (the created id). PUT /master/x/{id} -> 200 with data = { id } (echoes path var). DELETE /master/x/{id} -> 200 with data = null. Keeps the Q29 ApiResponse<T>(status,statusText,data,timestamp) envelope on ALL endpoints (rejected bare 201/204 no-envelope for that reason). RATIONALE: old success body was a throwaway String ('Organisasi Saved') stuffed into data, never the entity -- so returning id-only is parity, not a loss. CRITICAL CQRS reason: the command service is JPA-ONLY and must NEVER call the JOOQ query service to assemble a Detail DTO on write -- that would couple the two CQRS sides on every mutation. Client re-GETs the Detail tier (/master/x/{id}) if it needs the full server-resolved record (e.g. level copied from Jabatan per ADR-0009). DUPLICATE/FAILED paths already handled by typed exceptions + @RestControllerAdvice (DuplicateResourceException->409, ResourceNotFoundException->404). NOT an ADR: reversible forward change, no surprising trade-off beyond the CQRS-split reasoning already captured.

Rewrite sisi baca (JOOQ/CQRS): client-driven projection, satu DTO per kebutuhan endpoint — BUKAN satu response gemuk dipakai semua (keluhan asli: ProfesiResponse lama dipakai di findAll/findByJabatan/findPage/findById sekaligus, selalu load organisasi+jabatan+level+grade+apdList+alatKerjaList walau cuma butuh id+nama). Pola STANDAR berulang untuk semua master: (1) *Option = id+nama saja, query ramping tanpa join (dropdown); (2) *Detail = full termasuk koleksi anak via JOOQ MULTISET (halaman detail). Tingkat menengah (list) DISESUAIKAN per kasus. DTO baca = Java record (immutable), terpisah total dari entity JPA; berhenti pakai Lombok @Data + static from(). Koleksi anak via MULTISET (emulasi JSON_ARRAYAGG MariaDB) 1 round-trip, bukan N+1. PETA KONKRET PROFESI (Q23, locked): /list->ProfesiOption(id,nama); /{id}->ProfesiDetail(semua scalar nama/detail/resiko + organisasi/jabatan/level/grade id+nama + apdList/alatKerjaList via MULTISET); /(page index)->ProfesiListItem(id,nama,resiko + nama FK, TANPA koleksi anak); /jabatan/{id}->ProfesiOption (reuse, dropdown). Jika frontend ternyata pakai /jabatan/{id} utk tabel, naikkan ke ProfesiListItem.

Rewrite (SB4, master-first): services are concrete @Service classes — NO interface+Impl split. Best practice (verified via context7/Spring Boot docs): constructor injection + @ComponentScan recommended; return concrete types for max type info; Spring never mandates an interface for single-impl beans. Old code had 55 interfaces / 53 Impl, all 1:1, none with a 2nd impl — dead polymorphism. CQRS pairs ProfesiCommandService (JPA write) + ProfesiQueryService (JOOQ read) both concrete. See docs/adr/0007-concrete-services-no-interface.md. KISS/YAGNI: extract interface later if a real 2nd impl appears.

CustomResult envelope 'timestamp' field in the SB4 rewrite is an Instant, serialized by Jackson 3 as ISO-8601 by default. Drop the old Jackson-2 '@JsonFormat(pattern="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")' / LocalDateTimeSerializer entirely — those won't compile under Jackson 3 (tools.jackson.* namespace) anyway. Rationale: timestamp is a machine-readable server-response marker; ISO-8601 Instant is unambiguous and zero-config.

Rewrite master simple lookups (Level, JenisKeahlian, JenisKitas, JenisPelatihan, AlasanBerhenti, RumahDinas, JenjangPendidikan, Golongan + richer HariLibur/JenisSp/Sanksi): PER-ENTITY CONCRETE classes (Q chose A), NOT a generic AbstractMasterCrudService/Controller. Rationale: genericizable surface (command orchestration) is small; non-genericizable surface is large — JOOQ read side inherently per-table (generated table classes, hand-built projections), per-entity field divergence (Golongan has NO nama -> golongan+pangkat; JenjangPendidikan +seq/isStatistik; RumahDinas +nilai Double; AlasanBerhenti +notes), and only Level carries UNIQUE(nama) -> revive-on-create per ADR-0005 while the other 7 flat lookups are non-unique. Profil QueryService (JOOQ read side) scoping: nik is a REQUIRED method parameter, not an optional IndexQuery filter. Methods: pageByNik(String nik, XxxIndexQuery), listByNik(String nik), getById(Long id). Reason: profil reads are intrinsically tenant-scoped to one pegawai (a pegawai reads only their own rows; SDM reads one pegawai's rows; no 'all profil across everyone' screen exists). Making nik a parameter guarantees the JOOQ WHERE biodata_nik=? predicate is always present at the type level, preventing accidental full-table scans that would leak every employee's data. This DIVERGES from master ProfesiQueryService which is globally scoped (pageQuery(IndexQuery)/listQuery()/getById). The Query row DTO carries the changedStatus boolean so UI flags per-row 'menunggu persetujuan'.

Biodata read-side shape is the EXCEPTION to the Q9 profil child-scoping rule. Biodata has NO parent — it IS the pegawai (keyed by NIK String). Its global list is a LEGITIMATE SDM directory-search surface: legacy BiodataRequest filters nik(LIKE), nama(LIKE), jenisKelamin, alamat, isPegawai. Authorization nuance DEFERRED to per-entity RBAC: global Biodata list/page should be SDM-only (a pegawai has no whole-directory search use case + privacy), while a pegawai reads own biodata via getByPegawaiId/their NIK — note it, do not enforce now.

Rewrite master (ProfesiDetail read side): apdList + alatKerjaList loaded via JOOQ MULTISET. On MariaDB MULTISET is emulated as group_concat(json_array(...) SEPARATOR ',') -> JSON; NO native MULTISET. KNOWN GOTCHA: MariaDB group_concat_max_len default = 1024 bytes/group; if a profesi's children JSON exceeds it MariaDB SILENTLY TRUNCATES -> malformed JSON -> JOOQ parse error (not graceful empty list). DECISION (Q27=A): keep MULTISET, rely on default, do NOT raise group_concat_max_len. Justification: APD + Alat Kerja per profesi are always small bounded lists (handful of {id,nama}), KISS. Documented assumption in CONTEXT.md. Revisit only if a real profesi ever exceeds the limit (then switch to SET SESSION group_concat_max_len).

Q30=B: rewrite mempertahankan struktur paket LAYER-FIRST proyek lama (controllers/master/, services/master/profesi/, repositories/master/, dto/master/profesi/), MENOLAK feature-first vertical slice meski tujuan rewrite menyebut 'vertical slice'. Pemisahan Command/Query tetap per-file (ProfesiCommandService/ProfesiQueryService + ProfesiQueries untuk DSL JOOQ) sesuai ADR-0001 — yang berubah hanya tempat file, bukan teknologinya. Alasan: diff mental lebih kecil, porting kode lama lurus. Trade-off: batas CQRS tidak co-located. Konvensi berlaku semua modul. Lihat docs/adr/0006-layer-first-package-layout.md.

Rewrite error path (ADR-0013): a single @RestControllerAdvice translates typed exceptions into the SAME ApiResponse<Object>(status,statusText,data,timestamp) envelope as success — NOT Spring 7's framework-default ProblemDetail/RFC 9457. Mapping: MethodArgumentNotValidException->400 with data=list of 'field : message' strings (parity with old ErrorResult.build(Errors)); bad-FK EntityNotFoundException from getReferenceById->409 (ADR-0008); not-found on update/delete->404; data=null for 409/404. Old code had NO @ControllerAdvice anywhere — every controller threaded Errors and returned ErrorResult.build(errors) inline (400-only, no throw). That inline pattern is REJECTED (can't reach 409/404). Centralization is forced; the fork resolved was envelope SHAPE. Chosen A=symmetric ApiResponse (one shape client-wide, KISS, FE never consumes RFC9457 type URIs) over B=ProblemDetail (rejected: two shapes per outcome). Controllers stop returning ErrorResult inline -> they throw, advice shapes body. Advice is a foundation-slice artifact built alongside ApiResponse/PageResult before any master endpoint. Verified SB4/Spring7 ProblemDetail default via context7.

Q29=A: rewrite success envelope is ONE flat Java record ApiResponse<T>(int status, String statusText, T data, Instant timestamp) used for single/list/page alike (page's data field holds the PageResult<T> record from Q25). Preserves the existing frontend JSON contract {status,statusText,data,timestamp} documented in CLAUDE.md. DROPS the old message/errors fields and the null/empty->404 logic (those move to @RestControllerAdvice + ResourceNotFoundException). status/statusText stay duplicated in JSON purely for backward-compat. Replaces the old Lombok @Data ResultAbstract/SingleResult/ListResult/PageResult hierarchy.

Rewrite master index-filter DTO 'XQuery' is an immutable Java record (NOT mutable @Data like old CommonPageRequest). Spring 6.1+ DataBinder binds query params into record constructors (context7-verified), incl. nested structures + @BindParam. Pagination fields are NOT inheritable since records can't extend a base class, so a single shared record PageQuery(int page, int size, String sortBy, String sortDirection) is COMPOSED into each XQuery, e.g. record ProfesiQuery(Long organisasiId, Long jabatanId, Long levelId, Long gradeId, String nama, PageQuery page). Query params get a 'page.' prefix (?page.size=20&page.sortBy=nama&organisasiId=3). DRY: pagination defined+defaulted once. Replaces old XRequest extends CommonPageRequest + getSpecification(). NOT an ADR (reversible, low surprise). Relates to rewrite-master-dto-naming, rewrite-jooq-page-query.

Mapper hanya merakit Profesi dari parameter (set FK, derive level=jab.getLevel(), set scalar). Alasan: mudah ditest, reusable lintas jalur tulis (bulk import bisa batch-load FK sendiri). rewrite write-side error handling: command service tulis happy-path saja, LEMPAR exception bertipe (ResourceNotFoundException->404 untuk FK/id tak ada; DuplicateResourceException->409). Satu @RestControllerAdvice memetakan exception->ErrorResult dgn status benar, DAN menyerap MethodArgumentNotValidException shg blok 'if(errors.hasErrors())' per-controller DIHAPUS (DRY). Pensiunkan ESaveStatus/SavedStatus/SavedResult di sisi tulis; respons sukses save = CustomResult.any(dto) 201. Sisi BACA tetap pakai CustomResult.any/list/page utk respons sukses. Catatan jujur: pola lama SavedResult sebenarnya sudah map SUCCESS->201/DUPLICATE->409/FAILED->400, jadi alasan ganti BUKAN status salah, tapi: hapus try/catch(Exception) yg menelan semua jadi FAILED+bocorkan e.getMessage mentah, dan bedakan 404 FK-not-found dari 400.

Profil read-side DTO split (mirrors master ProfesiQuery/ProfesiDetail): each profil entity gets XxxQuery (lean list/index row) + XxxDetail (richer single-row, joined label fields). changedStatus boolean lives on BOTH — list row needs it for the per-row 'menunggu persetujuan' badge; detail needs it because that's the screen where SDM acts on the pending change (approve/reject affordance), and it's a free boolean already on the current-table row. Both are plain JOOQ reads off the current table, NO revision metadata (consistent with Q6: read side reads current table only).
